# CrossFit Games

> > Official hub for the CrossFit Games competition season, from the Open through Semifinals to the Finals, crowning the Fittest on Earth.

This site serves as the central resource for CrossFit's global competitive season, covering registration, schedules, workouts, leaderboards, and event information across all divisions. It includes guides for beginners through elite athletes, affiliate competitions like the Community Cup, and specialized events for service members.

## Key Topics

- CrossFit Open
- CrossFit Games Finals
- Fittest on Earth
- Semifinals
- Community Cup
- Leaderboard and scoring
- Competition divisions (Rx, Scaled, Masters, Adaptive)
- Season structure and qualification
- Workout standards and movements
- SAP Center San Jose
- Greg Glassman
- Licensed Events
- Service Cup
- Affiliate competitions

## Competition Overview & Getting Started

- [About the Games](https://games.crossfit.com/about-the-games): About CrossFit Games: competition structure, history, Fittest on Earth
- [Overview of the 2026 CrossFit Open](https://games.crossfit.com/open/overview): 2026 CrossFit Open overview: registration, competition dates, and leaderboard
- [Overview of the 2026 CrossFit Games](https://games.crossfit.com/finals/overview): 2026 CrossFit Games overview: tickets, venue info, San Jose competition
- [Want to Compete in the Games?](https://games.crossfit.com/article/want-compete-games/open): Getting started guide: CrossFit training, Open registration, qualification
- [A Beginner's Guide to CrossFit](https://games.crossfit.com/article/beginners-guide-crossfit): Beginner's guide to CrossFit by Greg Glassman: scaling and programming

## Season Structure & Dates

- [The 2026 CrossFit Games Season: Dates & Details by Division](https://games.crossfit.com/article/2026-crossfit-games-season-dates-and-details-division): 2026 season structure: dates, divisions, Open through Finals by division
- [2025 CrossFit Games Season: Dates and Details by Division](https://games.crossfit.com/article/get-ready-2025-crossfit-games-season): 2025 season overview: structure changes, dates, Community Cup, divisions
- [The CrossFit Games Schedule](https://games.crossfit.com/finals/schedule): 2026 CrossFit Games schedule by division at SAP Center, San Jose

## Competition Guides & How-Tos

- [I Signed Up For the CrossFit Open. Now What?](https://games.crossfit.com/article/i-signed-crossfit-open-now-what): CrossFit Open guide: score submission, dashboard setup, competition prep
- [How to Read the CrossFit Games Leaderboard](https://games.crossfit.com/article/how-read-crossfit-games-leaderboard): Leaderboard guide: ranking system, point-per-place scoring explained
- [How to Watch the 2025 CrossFit Open](https://games.crossfit.com/article/how-watch-2025-crossfit-open): 2025 CrossFit Open viewing guide: live announcements, athlete matchups
- [2025 CrossFit Games Tickets](https://games.crossfit.com/article/2025-crossfit-games-tickets): 2025 CrossFit Games ticketing: Albany venue, packages, presale info
- [2025 CrossFit Semifinals: Frequently Asked Questions](https://games.crossfit.com/article/2025-semifinals-frequently-asked-questions): 2025 Semifinals FAQ: workout rules, equipment, movement standards
